Full finite rational and matrix checks from the included actual CHECK.py supplement—not replace—the proof.

value.rationale: Determines, uniformly for every strictly radial profile and every even cyclic length, exactly which of the full set of two-translation critical sampling schemes are usable and the dimension of every failure. For a natural geodesic exponential the all-gap determinant product and strict volume ordering select unique optimal sensor separations, quantifying global reconstruction volume rather than merely Riesz existence. This is an exact natural signal-design invariant with direct finite-dimensional synthesis/reconstruction use, not a tiny numerical improvement.
